title: 去 AI 痕迹词表与句式规则
description: 降 AI 技能的第一道关（词表级）。规则以正则匹配，命中即需改写；带 max_per_document 的规则是频次上限，超出部分才算命中（例如全文用一次「综上所述」可接受，堆砌则不行）。中英双语：规则本身同时覆盖中文与英文；英文规则（en-slop-*）面向英文稿件，整理自 petergyang/no-ai-slop，见 docs/no-ai-slop-reference.md。每条规则除 label/why/fix 外另有 label_en/why_en/fix_en，由 check_phrasing.py --lang 选择，缺英文时回退中文。词表是数据：加词只改本文件，检查器与文档同步生效。

usage.skipped_regions: 围栏代码块与行内代码跨度（反引号包裹），故规范文档里的反例不会被误报
usage.exit_codes: 0 通过 / 1 有命中 / 2 用法或环境错误
usage.message_language: --lang zh|en 决定提示文案、规则标签与改法的语言；缺少对应英文时回退中文。JSON 导出同时保留中英字段

rules.label: 模板腔开头
rules.why: 背景章以空泛的时代叙事开场，是 AI 写作最典型的痕迹，也最容易让评委判定「没读透题目」
rules.why_en: Opening a section with a vague era narrative is the most typical AI habit, and it signals that the writer never engaged with the actual material.
rules.fix: 以本题的具体矛盾、关键数字或经核实的文献切入，直入主题
rules.fix_en: Open on a concrete tension, a key number, or a verified source that bears on this piece.
patterns: 随着[^。；\n]{0,18}(的)?(快速|迅猛|不断|持续|日益)?(发展|推进|兴起|普及|推广)
在当今(社会|时代|信息时代|背景下)

rules.label: 过渡词滥用
rules.why: 靠「综上所述」「值得注意的是」串段落，段落之间没有信息量，读起来像模板拼装
rules.why_en: Chaining paragraphs with stock connectors puts no information between them; the text reads like assembled boilerplate.
rules.fix: 用信息量衔接替代：呼应上文的结论或点明下文的实质任务
rules.fix_en: Use a connective sentence that carries information: echo the previous conclusion or name the next task.

rules.label: 连接词链堆砌
rules.why: 「首先…其次…再者…最后」成体系出现是机器行文特征；规范只允许在一处求解流程内部使用一次
rules.why_en: A full first / second / moreover / finally chain is a machine-writing habit; the rulebook allows one such chain per document.
rules.fix: 连接链全文至多一组，且只用于单一求解流程的步骤引导；问与问之间改用信息量衔接
rules.fix_en: Keep at most one chain, and only to step through a single procedure; link sections with information-bearing sentences.

rules.label: 泛化升华
rules.why: 「具有重要意义」「填补空白」这类收尾不携带任何本题信息，是典型的套话
rules.why_en: Closers such as 'of great significance' or 'fills a gap' carry no information specific to this piece.
rules.fix: 落到具体场景、具体数值或具体迁移条件
rules.fix_en: Land on a concrete scenario, a concrete number, or a concrete condition for reuse elsewhere.
patterns: 具有(一定的)?(实际|参考|指导)价值

rules.label: 模板腔结果表述
rules.why: 用「较为理想」「效果较好」描述结果，等于没给结论；论文、报告等长文的结果必须是数值与对比
rules.why_en: Describing a result as 'fairly good' gives the reader no result; papers and reports need numbers and a baseline.
rules.fix: 改为具体数值 + 对比基准（如「较基准方案下降 12.4%」）
rules.fix_en: State the number plus the baseline, for example '12.4% below the baseline plan'.
patterns: 取得了?(良好|不错|理想)的?(效果|结果)
结果(有所)?(提升|改善|优化)(?!\s*\d)

rules.label: 无依据断言
rules.why: 「很明显」「大量数据表明」没有指向任何数据或文献，属于空泛表达
rules.why_en: Phrases such as 'clearly' or 'plenty of data shows' point at no data and no source.
rules.fix: 补上具体数值、图表编号或文献引用；补不上就删掉
rules.fix_en: Add the number, the figure or table number, or the citation; if you cannot, cut the sentence.
patterns: 很明显|显而易见|毋庸置疑
大量(的)?(数据|实验|研究|实践)(表明|证明|显示)
效果(非常|十分|极其)显著(?!\s*[（(]?p)

rules.label: 含糊词
rules.why: 结论含含糊糊，评委无法据此判分；确属不确定时必须给区间或条件
rules.why_en: A hedged conclusion leaves the reader unable to judge the claim; real uncertainty needs a range or a condition.
rules.fix: 给出区间、条件或阈值；无法量化就改写成明确的适用边界
rules.fix_en: Give the interval, condition or threshold, or state the boundary of validity plainly.
patterns: 可能有所(改善|提升|下降)

rules.label: 权威含糊（须给引用）
rules.why: 「研究表明」「专家认为」不给出处，既像 AI 编的，也触碰反造假红线
rules.why_en: 'Studies show' or 'experts believe' with no citation reads as invented and crosses the anti-fabrication line.
rules.fix: 补上可核实的文献出处；找不到出处就删掉该论据（宁缺毋假）
rules.fix_en: Name a verifiable source; if none exists, delete the claim rather than dress it up.

rules.label: 口语化主观
rules.why: 第一人称主观或口语词破坏学术语态
rules.why_en: First-person opinion and casual wording break the register the document needs.
rules.fix: 改用「本文」「该模型」「求解结果显示」作主语
rules.fix_en: Use the document, the model or the result as the subject instead of the writer.
patterns: 我觉得|我认为大概|我们认为大概

rules.label: 二元对照句式
rules.why: 「不是…而是…」被高频复用后成为公式化修辞（英文写作中的 not X but Y）
rules.why_en: Repeated 'not X but Y' framing turns into a formulaic rhetorical tic.
rules.fix: 直接陈述结论，或用数据对比代替修辞对比；同一段落不连用
rules.fix_en: State the conclusion directly, or compare numbers instead of rhetoric; never stack two in one paragraph.

rules.label: 冒号揭晓
rules.why: 「最关键的一点：…」是先卖关子再揭晓的网文笔法，不是学术表述
rules.why_en: A noun phrase, a colon, then a dramatic lowercase payoff is web-copy suspense rather than plain exposition.
rules.fix: 把结论前置，直接在主句里说出来
rules.fix_en: Put the conclusion in the main clause and say it outright.
patterns: 最(好|关键|重要|核心)的(部分|一点|地方)[:：]

rules.label: 伪洞察开场
rules.why: 「很少有人告诉你」「大家都忽略的是」以制造悬念代替论证
rules.why_en: 'Few people tell you' or 'what everyone ignores' builds suspense in place of an argument.
rules.fix: 删掉悬念铺垫，直接给出问题与依据
rules.fix_en: Cut the suspense and state the problem together with its evidence.
patterns: (很少有人|没人|没有人)(告诉|提到|注意|意识)

rules.label: 虚假深刻收尾
rules.why: 「未来已来」式格言收尾不承担论证功能
rules.why_en: An aphoristic closer such as 'the future is already here' carries no argumentative weight.
rules.fix: 收尾回到本题结论、适用边界或下一步的具体难点
rules.fix_en: End on this piece's conclusion, its boundary of validity, or the next concrete difficulty.
patterns: 在此(背景|前提)下[，,]?让我们

rules.label: 空泛形容词/程度堆砌
rules.why: 「至关重要」「极其重要」「显著提升」这类评价词不携带本题信息，等于用形容词代替结论
rules.why_en: Evaluative words such as 'crucial' or 'significantly improved' substitute adjectives for a conclusion and say nothing about this subject.
rules.fix: 删掉评价词，改为与本题直接相关的专业表述，并补上具体数值或机制
rules.fix_en: Drop the evaluation and state the professional claim with its number or mechanism.
patterns: 至关重要|举足轻重|重中之重
(十分|非常|极其|极为|尤为|格外)(重要|关键|突出|显著|优异)
(显著|明显|大幅|急剧)(提升|提高|改善|增强|降低|缩短|加快)(?!\s*[（(]?\s*\d)
不可否认|不言而喻|毋庸置疑|毫无疑问|普遍认为

rules.label: 冗长连接/铺垫语
rules.why: 「简而言之」「从某种意义上说」「不得不说」是为过渡而过渡，删掉后信息量不变
rules.why_en: 'In short' or 'so to speak' exist only to bridge; remove them and the information is unchanged.
rules.fix: 直接进入内容，或改用携带信息的衔接句（呼应上问结论、点明下问任务）
rules.fix_en: Go straight into the content, or use a connective that carries information.
patterns: 简而言之|一言以蔽之|总而言之
总的来说|总体来看|整体而言
从某种意义上(说|讲)|换个角度(看|来说)|不得不说

rules.label: 模板化目的句
rules.why: 「为了更好地…」「旨在…」「以期…」是模板腔的目的铺陈，常与后文实际做法重复
rules.why_en: 'In order to better ...' is a stock purpose preamble that usually repeats what the next sentence already says.
rules.fix: 直接陈述做法与目标，或点明具体要解决的矛盾
rules.fix_en: State the method and the goal directly, or name the specific tension being resolved.

rules.label: 英文套词/夸大词
rules.why: delve/leverage/streamline/cutting-edge 等是英文 AI 写作最典型的空洞词，替换成具体动作或事实即可
rules.why_en: delve, leverage, streamline and cutting-edge are the emptiest words in AI-written English; a concrete action or fact replaces them.
rules.fix: 改为具体动词与事实（leverage→use、streamline→cut steps、cutting-edge→new）
rules.fix_en: Use a concrete verb or fact: leverage becomes use, streamline becomes cut steps, cutting-edge becomes new.

rules.label: 英文空话/铺垫语
rules.why: it's worth noting / here's the thing / in other words 等短语拖后结论、不携带信息（整理自 no-ai-slop）
rules.why_en: Phrases such as 'it's worth noting' or 'here's the thing' push the conclusion back and carry no information.
rules.fix: 删掉铺垫直接说结论；确需过渡时用携带信息的句子替代
rules.fix_en: Delete the preamble and state the conclusion; if a transition is needed, make it carry information.
patterns: (?i)(it'?s worth noting|it is important to note|at the end of the day|when it comes to|at its core|in today'?s world|in the age of|in the world of|the reality is|the truth is|going forward|let'?s dive in|here'?s the thing|let me be clear|i'?ll be honest|the uncomfortable truth is|that last part matters|as you can see|the key point is|this distinction matters|in other words)

rules.label: 英文 slop 句式
rules.why: 二元对照、伪洞察、无出处断言、夸大意义与复述式收尾，均为 AI 英语写作的标志性句式（整理自 no-ai-slop）
rules.why_en: Binary contrasts, faux insight, unsourced assertions, inflated significance and recap endings are the signature sentence shapes of AI English.
rules.fix: 直接陈述结论、点名出处、给出事实；收尾停在最后一个具体结论上
rules.fix_en: State the conclusion, name the source, give the fact; stop on the last concrete point.
patterns: (?i)((most people|everyone) (skip|get wrong|miss)|(nobody|no one) tells you|what nobody tells you|the part (everyone|most people) (miss|skips))
(?i)(experts agree|studies show|research shows|widely regarded as|industry reports suggest)
(?i)(stands? as a testament|marks? a pivotal moment|plays? a (vital|crucial|key) role|solidifies? its position)

rules.label: 格式装饰（中英通用）
rules.why: 标题里塞 emoji、正文用表情符号当项目符号、连续 emoji 堆砌，都是用装饰代替内容；中英文稿件都会出现，英文里同时破坏正式语域
rules.why_en: Emoji in headings, emoji as bullets and runs of emoji substitute decoration for content in both languages; in English they also break the formal register.
rules.fix: 删掉 emoji 与表情符号，标题用文字表达层级；强调靠事实与数据，不靠符号；格式跟随内容，不装饰内容
rules.fix_en: Remove the emoji and let headings carry the hierarchy in words; emphasis comes from facts and numbers, not symbols.

rules.label: 破折号堆砌（中英通用）
rules.label_en: Dashes as a rhythm crutch (Chinese and English)
rules.why: 把破折号当节奏拐杖：英文里用带空格的 em dash 串句子，中文里连写多个破折号，都是靠标点制造语气，属于装饰性用法
rules.why_en: Leaning on dashes for rhythm, spaced em dashes in English or repeated dashes in Chinese, is decorative punctuation rather than structure.
rules.fix: 删掉装饰性破折号，改用逗号、句号或括号拆句；中文一个破折号写作「——」，不要连写；长文里带空格的 em dash 全文不超过 4 处
rules.fix_en: Cut the decorative dashes and use commas, full stops or parentheses; keep spaced em dashes under four per long draft.
